thread:
Ivy (Finance Ops): LedgerBeam sent a renewal with a hybrid seat+commit SKU. Looks a bit different from other vendors. Can procurement/eng/legal eyeball before we respond?
Ron (Procurement): On it. Key asks: 1) clear SKU list and mapping to invoice lines, 2) prepaid annual vs monthly commit economics, 3) migration credits and how they apply, 4) termination/cancellation terms.
Samir (Platform): Usage baseline: trailing-3mo avg = 410M tokens/mo, peak 95th = 690M. Two heavy routes: /chat (70%) and /embed (20%). Need per-key attribution and a webhook sample for our billing pipeline.
Marta (LedgerBeam Sales): Hey all 12 thanks for the ping. Short summary: we offer SEAT_30 (30 seats + 150M tokens) = $1,900/mo, HYBRID_600 (50 seats + 600M tokens) = $4,100/mo, COMMIT_900 = $6,000/mo. PAYG = $0.0065/1k tokens. Migration credit: 20% of first-year committed spend for 12mo commits, applied as monthly credits. Annual prepay gets 6% discount. SLA: 99.95% enterprise; standard 99.5.
Marta (LedgerBeam Sales): Sample webhook (metadata only): POST /hooks/usage
{ "customer_id":"rw-2468", "time":"2025-09-18T12:03:22Z", "tokens":980, "route":"/chat", "api_key":"svc-prod-7", "req_id":"r_xyz" }
Samir (Platform): Good. Does the webhook include billing SKU or only tokens+route+key? We'll need a field we can map to our internal route->product mapping. Also need monthly CSV export for reconciliation.
Marta (LedgerBeam Sales): Webhook includes route and api_key only. We can add an optional sku_hint field in enterprise contracts. Monthly CSV export available via secure bucket link per month.
Elise (Legal): From legal: data retention, purge-on-termination, DPA, subprocessors, non-auto-renew opt-out (30d) and any automatic rollup clauses. Also want termination penalty caps spelled out.
Marta (LedgerBeam Sales): Standard raw payload retention = 30 days; billing metadata 7 years. We can add purge-on-termination and DPA/SOC2 attestation in enterprise addendum. Termination: 60-day notice; prepaid refunds only with enterprise addendum.
Ron (Procurement): Please provide: - itemized SKU list (commit, seat, overage, premium support, SLA add-on) - sample invoice (we prefer Net30 or Net45 options) - confirmation on prepaid refund policy - whether overage discounts apply when on hybrid seat+commit
Marta (LedgerBeam Sales): I'll attach SKU sheet and a sample invoice. Net30 is standard; Net45 available for procurement teams with PO process. Overage discount: hybrid customers get 8% off PAYG overages if monthly usage <=120% of commit.
Ivy (Finance Ops): Quick calc: switching to HYBRID_600 might roughly match our 95th but seat allocation could be wasteful. Ron can you run a 2yr cashflow TCO comparing monthly commit vs annual prepay vs hybrid? Also ask Marta to include migration credit schedule and exact credit application on invoices.
Ron (Procurement): Will run TCO and share spreadsheet. Can we schedule a 30m call with LedgerBeam next Thu 9am PT? @Marta confirm?
Marta (LedgerBeam Sales): Thu 9am PT works. I'll upload quote, SKU mapping, sample invoice PDF, DPA, webhook schema, and CSV export spec by EOD Wednesday.
Samir (Platform): Once webhook spec and CSV sample arrive I'll validate ingestion and route attribution.
Elise (Legal): Please include explicit language for purge-on-termination and a subprocessor list.
Ivy (Finance Ops): Thanks everyone  we'll reconvene after the packet and Ron's TCO.
